subject: reasoning
question: Each of the digits in the number 3728645 is arranged in ascending order from left to right. What will be the sum of the digits that are second from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution:
**Given: **Each of the digits in the number 3728645 is arranged in ascending order from left to right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54ff46eeab979bdd73772ce1b977ae6eb870f271c8dc21cdd5a0d88e6d7a6ef0.png] 

Digit second from the left = 3

Digit second from the right = 7

sum = 3 + 7 = 10

Thus, 10&am
